ConnectionStrings.// SQLite database: Leave empty to use the default path (local app data folder)
ConnectionStrings.// Google Books API key: Optional. Leave empty to use the OpenLibrary API instead

Features.// Default duration for new loans in day: Defaults to 28 days, customizable in the UI
Features.// Default Bootstrap theme: Defaults to dark, customizable in the user's browser settings
Features.// Launch browser on startup: Defaults to false, open the app in the default web browser when the server starts
Features.// Shutdown if no active users: Defaults to true, automatically stops the application if no active users connected
Features.// Online book search: Supported values: disabled, automatic, fallback, manual. Defaults to automatic.
Features.// Online movie search: Supported values: disabled, automatic, fallback, manual. Defaults to automatic.
Features.// Online music disc search: Supported values: disabled, automatic, fallback, manual. Defaults to automatic.
